symptom: After forced reset from gpu-off-debug, kShimC no longer displayed NixOS entries.
cause: Clean-state value was 1, but ext4 incompat features included needs_recovery (0x4). The read-only kShimC ext4 reader rejects this flag.
offline_trial: Replayed journal on a reflink copy; kShimC parser then found all seven entries and verified all payload hashes. Full e2fsck -fn passed.
device_repair: e2fsck -p -E journal_only on the unmounted, UUID/size-verified partition; full read-only e2fsck passed afterwards.
physical_menu_confirmation: User confirmed entries restored and booted original current
prevention: Future diagnostic variants mount /boot ro and disable automatic boot cleanup; normal daily configuration remains separately maintained.
